# Vazirmatn (bundled font)

Persian UI font, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`, authors in `AUTHORS.txt`).

- Source: npm package `vazirmatn@33.0.3` (https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn), tarball SHA-256
  `9506e9e6a27e62b353c04a136c27de0cc3aa9e434658b45a6363f7c98c357090`.
- Files used, copied unmodified from `fonts/ttf/` and renamed to the lowercase names Android needs
  (`app/src/main/res/font/`):

| File in the app | Original | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vazirmatn_regular.ttf` | `Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf` | `b69fd4c680b8f3f225feabcc655a2c585d97627b8f5f5c0f9985e894069f3a56` |
| `vazirmatn_medium.ttf` | `Vazirmatn-Medium.ttf` | `b986623e4ddef10755e04be39f8ea7bcb1dc08bfe8dd0aa6af395736f256ad4a` |
| `vazirmatn_bold.ttf` | `Vazirmatn-Bold.ttf` | `f635fdbea28f265de395ba83b4b1570dcf2f58d13c65469e61903b1c2d2ae723` |

To upgrade: download the new package, replace the three files, update the versions and hashes above.
